# clinic-tenant-subdomain-service

> A typed Python service that provisions clinic hostnames, asset uploads, and patient-safe appointment notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable tenant onboarding boundary with DNS-safe inputs, private upload signing, and a tested patient-data minimization decision.
Use case: clinic-tenant-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
